changeSet.author: isv
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_devicelog_log ( id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, createTime BIGINT, customerId INT NOT NULL, deviceId INT NOT NULL, applicationId INT NOT NULL, ipAddress VARCHAR(512), severity TEXT, severityOrder INT, message TEXT, CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_log_pr_key PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_log_customerId_fkey FOREIGN KEY (customerId) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_log_deviceId_fkey FOREIGN KEY (deviceId) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_log_applicationId_fkey FOREIGN KEY (applicationId) REFERENCES applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB;

changeSet.author: isv
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_devicelog_settings ( id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, customerId INT NOT NULL, logsPreservePeriod INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_settings_pr_key PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_settings_customerId_fkey FOREIGN KEY (customerId) REFERENCES customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB;

changeSet.author: isv
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO plugin_devicelog_settings (customerId) SELECT id FROM customers;

changeSet.author: isv
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE plugin_devicelog_settings_rules ( id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, settingId INT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, applicationId INT NOT NULL, severity TEXT NOT NULL, filter TEXT, groupId INT, configurationId INT, CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_settings_rules_pr_key PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_settings_rules_settingId_fkey FOREIGN KEY (settingId) REFERENCES plugin_devicelog_settings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_settings_rules_applicationId_fkey FOREIGN KEY (applicationId) REFERENCES applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_settings_rules_groupId_fkey FOREIGN KEY (groupId) REFERENCES groups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT plugin_devicelog_settings_rules_configurationId_fkey FOREIGN KEY (configurationId) REFERENCES configurations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB;
